run_kmeans_clustering: run faiss Kmeans to cluster float32 vectors into k centroids and check the objective decreases each iteration
run_weighted_clustering: run faiss Clustering with per-sample weights to bias centroids toward heavily weighted data points
run_encoded_clustering: run faiss Clustering on scalar-quantized encoded codes via train_encoded to avoid full decompression
run_progressive_dim_clustering: run faiss ProgressiveDimClustering to cluster data progressively across dimension subsets for better objectives
run_1d_clustering: run faiss Clustering1D to optimally cluster 1D data and compare objective against standard Kmeans
